mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 trading days signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% in the next month signals weakening labor demand, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the next 20 days indicates a robust economic expansion, lowering risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and FEDFUNDS decreases over the next 20 trading days
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined trend of rising GDP and falling rates.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) alongside a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the next 20 days reflects robust supply-side growth and accommodative monetary policy, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases and FEDFUNDS decreases over the next 20 trading days
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined trend of rising INDPRO and falling rates.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) over the next 60 trading days signals cooling price pressures, prompting market anticipation of a soft landing and reduced rate hikes, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL declining from 259.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 in the next 5 trading days indicates weakening demand in the housing market, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1500 in the next 5 trading days
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite HOUST declining below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the next 60 days signals labor market tightening and monetary policy tightening, amplifying economic slowdown concerns and pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases and FEDFUNDS increases over the next 60 trading days
regime_hint: tightening labor market and monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the combined trend of rising UNRATE and FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the next 20 days reflects robust demand-side and supply-side expansion, lowering risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and INDPRO increases over the next 20 trading days
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined trend of rising GDPC1 and INDPRO.
